svg.text: 60 site × gene cells tested, 32 at q < 0.05; the strongest:
Cumulative incidence of CNS/Brain by EGFR, death competing
EGFR alteredn = 1,350 · 364 with CNS/Brain, 255 died first · 12 mo 14.2%, 24 mo 20.7%, 60 mo 32.0%
EGFR not alteredn = 5,107 · 1,042 with CNS/Brain, 1,712 died first · 12 mo 12.8%, 24 mo 17.7%, 60 mo 22.7%
Sites are the values of TUMOR_SITE on Diagnosis timeline events, at any date: a patient with any site recorded is evaluable for every site, and has a site when an event
names it. The timeline's tumour sites include the primary tumour's own organ, so the column for the organ a cancer type starts in mostly records primaries. Per site and
gene, the patients evaluable for the site and profiled for the gene (a mutation panel listing it, or whole-exome; a patient not profiled is in neither group, never wild-type)
are split by metastasis there and by a mutation the OncoKB store (v7.5) calls oncogenic or likely oncogenic in the gene called on a covering panel, in any of their samples.
The 2×2 tables are stratified by CANCER_TYPE per patient (“Multiple” when samples disagree, a stratum of its own; 2 strata), and tested by the
Cochran–Mantel–Haenszel test (continuity-corrected) with the Mantel–Haenszel common odds ratio — so a gene is compared with metastasis WITHIN cancer types, and
a cancer type that both carries the gene and spreads to the site does not make the association by itself. A cell is tested with at least 5 altered patients, 5 with the site and
5 without; Benjamini–Hochberg q over the 60 cells tested. The colour is log2 of the odds ratio. A site is only recorded where imaging, biopsy or the source's own
abstraction found it, so detection follows practice (who was scanned, how often, which sites are biopsied); patients sequenced from a metastasis are more likely to have
that site recorded. Associations are not adjusted for stage, time followed, treatment or tumour mutation burden. The lower panel: cumulative incidence of the first
CNS/Brain event after the timeline's day 0 for patients profiled for EGFR, altered against not, death (OS_STATUS) competing, Aalen–Johansen with delta-method 95%
intervals; patients with the site at or before day 0 are excluded rather than counted as free of it (EGFR altered 411, EGFR not altered 941), as are those without follow-up.
Censoring at OS_MONTHS on the timeline's clock; 0 patients of 6,457 have the event after the last follow-up (refused above 5%). Gray's test by permutation (2000
